Import button bottom right is grey (disabled). Back button active. The uploaded file content and the earlier Delete of Y1 are not shown.

No picture shows Y1 was deleted first (step 2); add before evidence for a developer to follow.
Round 4 BA answer was given by the user acting as BA in lead chat, not by the BA directly.

Draft says 'Confirm'; screen button is labelled 'Import'. Use the on-screen label.
Likely same root cause as the breakdown-not-deleted defect (ETM-8767); cross-link both.
Only the message differs; the row is still rejected and Import disabled, so impact is message accuracy only.
summary: ภาพแสดงข้อความ 'already associated with another work' แทน 'The UUID you entered is not exist in the system.' ตาม AC 3.4 และคำตอบ BA รอบ 4 ส่วนปุ่ม Import ถูกปิดตามที่คาด จึงถือว่า defect พิสูจน์ได้ แต่ควรแนบไฟล์ที่อัปโหลดและภาพตอนลบ Y1 เพื่อให้ dev ทำซ้ำได้
